request.subject: UNIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change two things only. Erase the yellow sun at the bottom left completely, leaving that area transparent. Make the sword he holds point-down a much bigger two-handed greatsword: a broad steel blade twice as wide, reaching the ground between his feet, with a wide gold crossguard at his chest. Do not redraw anything else: keep the plumed helmet, face, plate armour, pauldrons, crimson tabard, pose, proportions, feet, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
